reviews.author: Christopher Stenger
reviews.text: I had an intermittent metallic knocking noise somewhere in the drivetrain that several friends and different mechanic shop couldn't diagnose. It would shake the whole car but the other shop I've used in the past said bring it back when it is a consistent noise. Very frustrating because it didn't feel safe driving the car and so it had been sitting in my driveway while I was figuring out what to do. I heard great things about Cape Auto Repair so I decided to give diagnosis a shot at this shop. They got me in, and the owner said he had to drive it for a while, but they finally found what it was and promptly scheduled me to have the issue fixed. Thank you so much to the team at Cape Auto Repair for putting in the time to get my vehicle back on the road. Reasonable price, quality work, and great customer service. Really happy that I don't have a giant expensive question mark sitting in my driveway anymore and that this shop took the time and care to ensure their customer's issue was fixed.

reviews.author: Paul Piemonte
reviews.text: I was stranded heading back to Chicago going to get on the ferry and my starter went out I had my truck towed to Cape Auto Repair and so glad I did as I mentioned to the tow truck driver and the Uber driver where I brought it I kept hearing the owners name Chip saying that he was a really great mechanic and had fair prices. Chip and his wife did not disappoint they had my truck fixed in a few hours for a fair price! Thank you so much for saving the day. I would highly recommend Cape Auto for automotive repairs!!

reviews.author: Helen Ball
reviews.text: Saved the day! Was about to depart the ferry when I could clearly see a larger than life bolt in my tire and my tire pressure was abismal. Found them online and very close to terminal. Everyone from the office manager who answered my call and rung me up, the gentleman who inspected and repaired my tire while communicating everything going on, to who I assume was the owner/manager who was also there were great to interact with. Thanks for solving my travel concerns quickly and adorably. I even made it to my destination without anyone realizing what had happened.

reviews.author: kbwelborn2
reviews.text: Amazing! We start our car to get on the ferry get strange clicking noise, the dash board lights up and the car is smoking! Searched on-line for auto repair shop! They had great reviews. They are only a little over a mile away from ferry terminal. Called the shop a pleasant voice answered the phone, said to have car towed over. Come to find out needed a starter. They were on it. Two and half hours later, we were boarding the ferry. Everyone was amazing. The mechanic skilled and thorough. We went and had lunch at Uncle Bill's great place two blocks down. An aweful situation was turned into a great experience!

reviews.author: Kierjo
reviews.text: I called to have them look at my brakes because of a noise, and it was a busy Monday and they managed to get me in to look at my wife’s car and had it done the next morning. I had other things done here and always a great experience. I love keeping it local too. Fair and honest place!!

reviews.author: Jesse Cancelmo
reviews.text: Highly recommend! Excellent service. Oil change and multi-checks. Even had them check my spare tire pressure (don’t forget that one). They are my go-to after a horrible experience at Riggins including much rudeness.

reviews.author: Kathy Hunter
reviews.text: This review is long over due. I have been having my cars serviced here for five years and I will tell you five stars is not enough. Chip and Samantha don't just treat you like family,they treat you better than family. They are HONEST,FRIENDLY and have always gone above and beyond to relieve all the stress you sometimes get with car trouble. Chip is an outstanding technician and Samantha is ALWAYS happy and seems to put your mind at ease. They also have an exceptional greater with four paws and fur that makes you smile as soon as you walk in. i have worked in service departments my whole life and I promise you if you need a car repair Cape Auto is where you want to go!!!

reviews.author: Pat Rosselli
reviews.text: I am an elderly lady and lost my husband last year so I was lost when taking care of the car. The folks at Cape Auto made me feel safe and their kindness is most appreciated. They explain everything. I recommend them highly.

reviews.author: Kim
reviews.text: Excellent experience! We needed a tire patched while on vacation. Dropped our car off, went to breakfast and it was ready when we were finished eating! Pleasant people, efficient service, very reasonably priced. Thank you so much!!!

reviews.author: Linda Straub
reviews.text: I have had my car serviced at Cape May Auto for years. Great service, excellent repairs and reasonably priced. The owners, Samantha and Chip are beyond wonderful.

reviews.author: Dennis Welsh
reviews.text: Chip is the man. Been going to him for years now and I can always trust in his wisdom and guidance for car maintenance. His team is super efficient and has saved me a lot of headache since I moved back to Cape May. His pricing on top of all is insanely fair. If you’re a local and want top tier service and a friendly group, support Cape Auto Repair, if you’re out of town and in need of help this is your place. Thank you Chip and crew for everything you do.

reviews.author: Noel Rodriguez
reviews.text: We're from out of town, and had trouble with our vehicle. Chip, Samantha, and they're customer relations rep, Cooper squeezed us in to check out the problem. They were precisely on point, and took care of it. We're very happy we went to them. I truly HIGHLY recommend them for car service. God bless you guys we appreciate you.

reviews.author: Diane Grecsek
reviews.text: 5 Stars are just not enough for this business! I am thinking more like 10 stars! Cape Auto has the most knowledgeable mechanics! Just an all around great team. Chip, Samantha and the entire crew!!! So happy I found you years ago!!

reviews.author: Janice Tyson
reviews.text: My engine light was on and flashing We were vacationing in Cape May. Patty at the Periwinkle Inn recommended Chip at the Cape Auto Repair Shop. We were returning to Deleware the next day. I called and Samantha was so kind and helpful. She spoke with Chip and they said to bring my car right in. They went out of their way to assist us. Wonderful people, skilled staff. I highly recommend their services.

reviews.author: james mongiovi
reviews.text: A loyal customer for several years Good service. However, had oil changed on 1-11-24 and next day developed an oil leak. Chip called it a coincidence and recommended me to another shop which I gladly agreed. Not pointing blame but….totally disappointed. Would not recommend!

reviews.author: Erinnisse Rebisz
reviews.text: I am so grateful to have found Cape Auto Repair. I had car failure while traveling and they were the closest repair shop to me. To make a long story short, they got my car running again, so I could make it home to NY. They are very kind people to accommodate my emergency amidst there full calendar. They were so thorough to find what was broken, get it fixed, and be as certain as can be that we could travel with no further problems. Thank you Cape Auto Repair! We made it home.

reviews.author: Matt Faragasso
reviews.text: Can't thank Chip, and the team enough. We've been using Cape Auto for the past 2 years for our 2 cars and am extremely happy with the level of service they consistently provide. Chip takes his time to thoroughly explain things, and makes suggestions based on his knowledge/ experience. He's a small local shop, but with big name quality to back it up. His prices are crazy fair too!

reviews.author: carla drake
reviews.text: Everyone who works there is so nice. Chip is very honest and reasonable and always communicates different options for every problem. I will never take our cars anywhere else. There is no reason to. Amazing experience every time.

reviews.author: Keith Eshelman
reviews.text: The entire team is very attentive and courteous. I have a Kia soul That I had a nail in the tire They ordered me a new tire that was needed and was very reasonable on price. Samantha was very cordial and had excellent customer service. Thank you for everything !!! Keith

reviews.author: Filipp
reviews.text: Chip and his team are absolute All-Stars. Courteous, fast, and most importantly CHILL AF. Fixed my flat tire in a matter of minutes and didn't mind that I was meandering around the car while they did it. You don't get service like this where I'm from (NNJ). Support local businesses like these!!

reviews.author: Ken Clark
reviews.text: In and out in 20 minutes for an oil change. Where else in Cape May County can you get that type of service? Polite, courteous and they actually performed the service they had promised me when I made the appointment. Chip, Samantha and their team of mechanics have won me over. I definitely will be telling my friends about Cape Auto Repair!!!

reviews.author: Maria Usbeck
reviews.text: After having some car issues on the road on our way to Cape May for the weekend, we went to Cape Auto Repair and Cliff was unbelievable helpful. Even stayed a few extra hours on Friday to get out car fixed and ready. This place is super reliable and they are extremely professional. Very happy we went there. I recommend it to anyone visiting or if you live in the area. A+

reviews.author: jack doc
reviews.text: So I’m originally from Bucks County and had a great mechanic who did all the work on my cars and my brothers and Dads cars. Moved down here and just found my go to team - Chip and his team at Cape Auto Repair on Bayshore Rd! They fixed my break issue that was caused by a dealership that just didn’t do it the right way! He did not once take a shot at the dealership and just said it happens. He was very professional, honest, and took the time to explain everything to me - such a breath of fresh air! His wife in the office was great and his puppy Cooper (who looked like a full grown dog) was also friendly. They are my team for everything on my cars! I really like these folks!! The reason I went to them is because I’m done with the car dealerships and add-ons every time I go there BUT the real reason is how they handled my elderly father a year ago. My Dad had a tire that couldn’t inflate. He will be 94 next month (92 at the time) and is a WWII vet who wears his hat of his division proudly. There was a stone in the stem. Chip and his team found it and removed it. My Dad was thrilled and asked how much. Should have been $10 or $20 but Chip said “no charge we owe you for your service to our country”!! This shop is an all around class act!!! Thanks Chip and team! JackDoc

reviews.author: Scott Sill
reviews.text: This place is awesome! Very clean and organized which I love, it shows how well he will treat my vehicle. Waiting room is clean and has water and coffee for you. My vehicle gets repaired quickly and a very fair price. Highly recommend Cape Auto Repair!

reviews.author: Bernadette McGroarty
reviews.text: This is the best auto repair shop in Cape May County. I have gone to at least different garages in the cape may area. All took at least a week to repair my car and all charges outrageous rates. I was so disappointed that I was ready to trade my 97 Toyota car in as every time I had service I would develop a new problem. This is the most honest shop that I have encountered in all my years. They explain everything on laymen's terms and make sure that all work is thoroughly done. My bill was the lowest one that I have had in 10 years.

reviews.author: Jim Brighter
reviews.text: Went to Cape Auto Repair because I had a tire that would not hold air. They promptly checked the tire, found the leak, and mounted my spare. My tire type was not in stock and I was in a time crunch. They told me where I could find my tire locally and sent me on my way. Fair pricing and very friendly, helpful staff!

reviews.author: Lori M
reviews.text: Chip at Cape Auto Repair went above and beyond to help my friend and I who were traveling from MA. Very professional, honest, explained everything clearly and very reasonably priced. Thank you again, Lori and Ruth, MA

reviews.author: Kathy Tracy
reviews.text: My daughter took my car here today!I am amazed at the job they did very friendly people and made sure the car was safe to drive they replaced the door handle fixed the window frame! I’m a senior citizen so my daughter took it in thanks chip and Samantha for being so kind you found yourself a forever customer 5+++++++

reviews.author: Stephanie Holvick RN
reviews.text: Stopped to get gas. Newly purchased vehicle would not start. Mechanic did all he could in 90 degree heat to help. He finally got us a tow to dealer. He was so knowledgeable however our jeep moab has some type of gremlin. Even the dealership could pinpoint. So friendly and helpful

reviews.author: Rachel Gutmann
reviews.text: After arriving in Cape May from Pittsburgh, the front of the driveshaft on my 2000 Honda CRV broke off and dropped. Since we were just beginning our beach trip, we needed a mechanic to take the driveshaft completely off, leaving our car front-wheel drive, but still operable. Samantha and Chip saved our vacation. They fit us in on a Saturday morning even though they were fully booked, and they had my car in safe driving condition within an hour of calling them. Very nice people, we can’t thank them enough!

reviews.author: Herbert Bean
reviews.text: I am really impressed with the high quality and professional work that was done on my truck, along with the very fast service. In all this business is. Just a nice place to do business. Thank all of you for your kindness. Herb Bean

reviews.author: Mitchell
reviews.text: Great prices, great service. Everything you try to avoid in a repair place (bad prices, unnecessary repairs, condescending explanations) is not a thing here. Quite the opposite: it’s local, friendly and quality service. This is an excellent spot and I highly recommend trying them if you’re new to the area or in need of better service. I’m about to move and it’s a shame I can’t take their services with me!

reviews.author: AJ Stelacio
reviews.text: Excellent customer service and care for my vehicle! Never does it feel like they are trying to upsell; a true pleasure to have reliable and honest auto mechanics right here!

reviews.author: Chuck Kane
reviews.text: Oil change was quick. Asked them to look at a few things on my car no charge like those big dealerships do. I will be going back. Good work at a fair price.

reviews.author: Damien Bourbeau
reviews.text: These guys are absolute legends. I was down here on vacation and the trunk of our G wagon wouldn’t open. Chip and Dylan came to the rescue. Do not hesitate to come here

reviews.author: stu d ' baker
reviews.text: Dang squirrel chewed into my gas fill hose causing it to leak . Chip found a replacement piece " Last one on the planet ". Hard to get parts ( 99 Mazda Milly ) ". I love living around the corner from such a good business . They have done a lot of work on a few of our cars . Always fixed or recommend what to do . Curse those squirrels .

reviews.author: K Warbz
reviews.text: The staff is always extremely professional and lead with kindness. They take care of my two cars and each and every time it is a pleasure to visit. Good job!

reviews.author: Jon Ruggeri
reviews.text: Took my 2022 Honda in today for flat tire,waited about 10 min,they jumped right on it. Very Professional and Friendly . Thank You ,Jon, N Cape May, NJ

reviews.author: eric guitarman
reviews.text: If I could give them 10 stars I would...my battery died near the end of vacation ..I wasn’t sure if it was just my battery or battery and alternator.. ..most places would try and over sell and say both needed replaced ...they tested my alternator free of charge ..(alt was good) determined it was just the battery ..he gave me a fair price on the battery and installed it for free...also they didn’t charge full price to come out and jump my vehicle ..cape auto saved the end of our vacation ..I actually caught a bunch of fish that last day thanks to them ...the owner has integrity ..you can trust this place...period..thank you so much cape auto repair!

reviews.author: Cliff baughman
reviews.text: Chip and his crew are honest about your vehicle and whatever issues it may have. Hands down best mechanic in Cape May County.

reviews.author: Robert Griffith
reviews.text: These guys are reliable , and fast. I have a small fleet of older work trucks, Chip keeps them on the road and making money for me.

reviews.author: Andrew K
reviews.text: I had a set of tires mounted and balanced. No hassle, fair pricing and friendly people. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Kubilay Aslan
reviews.text: It is an honest, smiling and quality place. This is the place you are looking for, a good and quality business.

reviews.author: James Allax
reviews.text: Great local business owned by great locals. Professional service, friendly and they really care about their customers. Will definitely be returning.

reviews.author: Alice Henry
reviews.text: Very nice owners husband and wife team Chip is extremely knowledgable and prices are fair Would highly reccomend this business!

reviews.author: Keith Roland
reviews.text: Great service - fast and courteous - stopped in for a slow tire leak - fixed and out the door in 10 mins!

reviews.author: NCapeMay
reviews.text: Stellar multipoint service, friendly, knowledgeable and welcoming staff, I'll see you again for the next scheduled maintenance!

reviews.author: Anthony Toffoli
reviews.text: Nice family owned shop and very experienced. They are also open on saturday mornings from 8 - 12 in the summer.

reviews.author: Jennifer Wilson
reviews.text: First time using this shop and they are awesome! Very fast and efficient! I would recommend highly!!

reviews.author: Lori Bulakowski
reviews.text: Highly recommended. Excellent service. Friendly. I had my car towed on Sunday. On a busy Monday they fit me in for a new starter and had my car back by the end of the day. I’ve Been to Cape Auto before and always good experience! Thank you…..

reviews.author: Guy Bramonte
reviews.text: These people are the Best. Thanks to Chip, Matt and Samantha, I made it home safely. Had brake problems with my truck upon arriving at my yearly vacation rental. I was concerned about how my truck was acting. Very unconfortable situation when you are two and a half hours from home and you have car problems. I told Chip that I just arrived for my vacation and had no other vehicle to use. Matt, one of his staff drove me home and picked me up 3 hours later. My truck was fixed perfectly at a reasonable price. Can't thank these guys enough. Highly recommended ! Great mechanic, honest, reasonable, fair and caring. Thanks again guys. Now home in Mercer County safe.

reviews.author: DeGisi Mark
reviews.text: Stopped over on a Monday in July at 4pm needed Freon for my A/C. The owner Chip was super nice and helpful. Had a tech check and fill my A/C. Was in and out very fast. Met his very nice wife Sam and their cool dog Cooper. Local family owned and you can really trust Chip.
